description: Supplement ground truth. After the settled baseline batch the autonomy chain runs the deterministic supplement agent, which proposes two ai_supplement cases. supplement_hit_rate = supplement cases matching a truth row / all ai_supplement cases (threshold >= 0.80). Truth rows are matched by their stable titles.
